_meta.rule: A crash counts for a block group if it is inside it or within 10 m of its boundary; crashes touching k boundary block groups are weighted 1/k.
_meta.notes: One layer per year (layer 2026 - year). 'Serious' = number_four_injuries (UDOT severity 4, suspected serious). Each year layer misses about one day at its edges (pipeline/region.py note).
_meta.counting_note: crashes = records the source returned for the county's bounding box (neighbouring counties included); with_coordinates = those with a location inside the box; matched = counted for at least one of this county's block groups; on_boundary = matched crashes counted for more than one block group. Crashes the source stores without a location are not returned by a map query, so their share is unknown here.
